name: Outreach
description: A local-first campaign workspace for thoughtful outbound work. Keep a small audience brief, draft with Ryu's configured model, review every recipient, and send only from an existing Ryu Mail inbox after an explicit confirmation. Outreach owns campaign intent and send status; Harbor CRM remains the system of record for customer data.

permission_levels.label: Can view
permission_levels.description: See campaign briefs, reviewed drafts, recipient readiness, and local send history.

permission_levels.label: Can edit
permission_levels.description: Create campaigns, change audience briefs, edit drafts, and choose which recipients are ready for review.

permission_levels.label: Can send
permission_levels.description: Send the explicitly selected, human-reviewed messages through an existing Ryu Mail inbox.
